scope: VisualBrief creation, imported-asset provenance and integrity classification, and explicit visual completion policy
assertions: a supplied screenshot preserves screenshot provenance and is never relabeled as generated
invalid bytes, MIME mismatch, oversized dimensions, missing usage notes, and unclear rights remain explicit risks
a VisualBrief binds revision, paragraph anchor, purpose, constraints, and source references without authorizing generation
a working draft can proceed with pending visuals while formal no-image completion requires an explicit decision
